knownLimits.title: Known limits
knownLimits.description: What the numbers above do not prove.

items.quotes: A profile quote proves that the quote is on the company's page, word for word. It does not prove that the quote supports the value shown next to it: that is what the team's hand-check is for.
items.euPortal: The EU Funding & Tenders portal answers 200 for any topic id, so a working EU link only means the portal is up. Energimyndigheten also answers 200 for a missing page.
items.model: Every model step (profiles, tags, the judge, trend notes, connections, Scout and the Copilot) runs on a free NVIDIA test model, nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b, not on Claude. Until the evening of 14 Nov 2026 it was the smaller nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b, so a run dated before then measured that model. Answers that fail the checks are asked again or dropped, never shown.
items.handEntered: Some sources are entered by hand by the team: regional funding, the curated testbed list and BSP's recurring events. They carry the Hand-entered label and change only when the team edits them.
items.redTeam: The red-team tests are the cases written in eval/redteam-prompts.json, each run once against the live model. Passing them does not prove the Copilot withstands every attack, and a new run can differ because the model's answers vary.
items.outputCheck: The Copilot's output check finds a stated fact by its numbers, dates, names and a few reporting verbs. It can miss a fact written without them, such as "the deadline is next week", and let it through without a source.

scout.title: Scout

Scout searches Blue Science Park's store of current opportunities, reads the pages it needs and writes a short brief in which every option cites its source. Each option is a potential match for you to check: whether you may take part is for the funder or the facility to decide.
